---
title: Bad contrast
brand: _brand.yml
format: mcanouil-html
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        description: A palette that fails the contrast check stops the render with the pair and the ratio.
    mcanouil-html:
      shouldError: true
      printsMessage:
        level: ERROR
        regex: 'mcanouil: contrast check failed: accent-text on paper \(light\) is [0-9]+\.[0-9][0-9]:1, below 4\.50:1\. Change accent-text or paper in _brand\.yml\.'
